heuristicPolicy.principle: Primary routes are selected by evidence strength, not rule order.
heuristicPolicy.higher-intensity: Requires a composite rise across at least two of propulsion, movement, and maximalism.
heuristicPolicy.lower-friction: Requires comfort gain that is not cancelled by rising emotion or maximalism.
heuristicPolicy.specific-routes: Emotion, belt, movement, narrative, and hooks compete by magnitude and may outrank broad routes.
heuristicPolicy.confidence: Uses evidence strength and winning margin, rather than route category alone.
